rows.Origin:
Bred by Meilland International (France, 2010).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Rose Tweed Nursery / Colin Gregory Roses Ltd as 'Ivory Romantica'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, copper shading. Moderate, tea rose fragrance. 100 petals. Average diameter 5.5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), button-eye, old-fashioned, quartered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Dark green foliage.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
